notes: Simulation / Physics Sim fits without any bending: breakable buildings whose collapse is the entertainment are physics-rig, and earthquake, tornado, flood and meteor are exactly the dynamic environmental events hazard-kill describes, all four layered over one shared space. Survival owns the word disaster in the index but the player here causes the disasters and nothing is survived, so I left it out of the genre list rather than naming it second. Shape is the preset's world-open in Simulation's own sense of one common world everyone operates in, and the answers settle the routing estimate outright - one large continuous city that takes a long time to cross on foot - so this stays P0 with no separate maps per district. Decided without a user: added settlement-density for the many dense blocks of varied building sizes, treated the flood as a disaster event rather than a standing water-body feature, kept the buildings as exteriors demolished from outside so no P3, and added no objective or scoring since the answers say destruction is the whole point.
